column1: File Description: Initial conditions in the year 1950 for the FAIR v2.0 simple climate model.
Code Source: Generated by scripts/generate_fair_1950_initial_conditions.jl from official MimiFAIRv2 1750 initial conditions and RCMIP historical emissions/forcing.
Paper Reference: Leach et al. 2021. FaIRv2.0.0: a generalized impulse response model for climate uncertainty and future scenario exploration.
Note: These values represent model state in 1950 after running FaIR from official 1750 initial conditions.
